result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I ran the `*Scoping*` tests and they passed. I didn't add tests for the new `.htm`, `<doc>` XML or `build-gradle.js` cases, so those matches aren't tested.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the file pattern was `.*[.](html|html|xhtml)`, with `html` listed twice. It is now `.*[.](html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match and `.html` and `.xhtml` still do.
- **.NET `<doc>` XML and `// Generated by` JavaScript:** the patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` only matched a file literally named `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`, so `MyAssembly.xml` and `app.js` can match. A file only lands in the generated scope if its content also matches, so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` only matched a file named `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. The separate `.*[.]gradle` rule that covers `build.gradle` is unchanged.
